findings.highlight: The bold promise made my father smile.
findings.evidenceJa: そう言い切る前に、父は微笑った。
findings.governingReading: His father smiles before he can finish saying he will realize the dream.
findings.explanation: The smile before the promise finishes loses its timing.

findings.highlight: His face said everything I needed to know.
findings.evidenceJa: 続きなんて聞くまでもないっていう顔だった。
findings.governingReading: The father’s face says he need not hear the remainder of Shirou’s promise.
findings.explanation: Kiritsugu need not hear the rest becomes Shirou needs no further information.

findings.highlight: On a winter night, the man I called my father looked up at the moon and entered a long sleep.
findings.evidenceJa: 何をするでもなく、冬の月と、長い眠りに入った、父親だった人を見上げていた。
findings.governingReading: After Kiritsugu dies, Shirou does nothing but look up at the winter moon and his deceased father.
findings.explanation: Shirou's quiet vigil over his father becomes another description of Kiritsugu looking at the moon and dying. The child's act of watching is lost.

findings.highlight: He picked up a burned, dying child and carried him out of hell, weeping with joy.
findings.evidenceJa: 意識もなく、全身に火傷を負って死にかけていた子供を抱き上げて、目に涙をためるぐらい喜んで、外に連れ出してくれた。
findings.governingReading: Kiritsugu carries out a child who is unconscious, burned all over, and near death, rejoicing with tears in his eyes.
findings.explanation: The rescue still involves a burned, dying child, but his explicit unconsciousness is omitted. No further conclusion about his awareness or memory follows.

findings.highlight: It pooled in my mouth while I slept, and every time I breathed, heavy, metallic air filled my lungs.
findings.evidenceJa: 口内に血が溜まっていたのか、呼吸をするだけでどろっとした空気が流れ込んできた。
findings.governingReading: He wonders whether blood had pooled in his mouth because breathing draws in thick air.
findings.explanation: Possible pooled blood becomes known pooling while he slept.

findings.highlight: I was just trying to give you a chance to survive because you literally don't know anything. It sounds like you still don't get it."
findings.evidenceJa: あれはね、何も知らない貴方が一人でも生き残れるようにって考えた結果なの。どうも、そのあたりを解ってなかったみたいね」
findings.governingReading: The church briefing was to enable ignorant Shirou to survive even without her beside him.
findings.explanation: Helping him survive alone loses alone.
